commands: # qa-ca.cnf: [req] | prompt = no | distinguished_name = dn | [dn] | CN = qa-ca | [v3_ca] | basicConstraints = critical,CA:TRUE | keyUsage = critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign | subjectKeyIdentifier = hash

(cd /tmp/omne-qa-t3-routes-RrB691/tls && openssl req -x509 -config /tmp/omne-qa-t3-routes-RrB691/tls/qa-ca.cnf -extensions v3_ca -newkey ec -pkeyopt ec_paramgen_curve:P-256 -pkeyopt ec_param_enc:named_curve -nodes -keyout qa-ca.key -out qa-ca.pem -days 3)
# qa-server.cnf: [req] | prompt = no | distinguished_name = dn | [dn] | CN = localhost

(cd /tmp/omne-qa-t3-routes-RrB691/tls && openssl req -new -config /tmp/omne-qa-t3-routes-RrB691/tls/qa-server.cnf -newkey ec -pkeyopt ec_paramgen_curve:P-256 -pkeyopt ec_param_enc:named_curve -nodes -keyout qa-server.key -out qa-server.csr)
